MERGE INTO CHB_SALER_INST_INFO CII USING (
select #{item.salerInstCode,jdbcType=CHAR} SALER_INST_CODE, #{item.salerInstName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SALER_INST_NAME, #{item.salerOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SALER_ORG_CODE, #{item.salerOrgName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SALER_ORG_NAME, #{item.salerOrgLevel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SALER_ORG_LEVEL, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} DATA_DATE, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REMARK, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.SALER_ORG_CODE = TEMP.SALER_ORG_CODE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.SALER_INST_NAME = TEMP.SALER_INST_NAME, CII.SALER_INST_CODE = TEMP.SALER_INST_CODE, CII.SALER_ORG_NAME = TEMP.SALER_ORG_NAME, CII.SALER_ORG_LEVEL = TEMP.SALER_ORG_LEVEL, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.DATA_DATE = TEMP.DATA_DATE, CII.REMARK = TEMP.REMARK, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SALER_INST_CODE, SALER_INST_NAME, SALER_ORG_CODE, SALER_ORG_NAME, SALER_ORG_LEVEL, STATUS, DATA_DATE, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values( TEMP.SALER_INST_CODE, TEMP.SALER_INST_NAME, TEMP.SALER_ORG_CODE, TEMP.SALER_ORG_NAME, TEMP.SALER_ORG_LEVEL, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.DATA_DATE, TEMP.REMARK, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME )
